question: How many TikTok videos did Creator E post in September 2026?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM posts p JOIN accounts a ON a.account_id = p.account_id JOIN creators c ON c.creator_id = a.creator_id JOIN platforms pl ON pl.platform_id = a.platform_id WHERE c.name = 'Creator E' AND pl.name = 'TikTok' AND p.posted_at LIKE '2026-09%'

question: Which creator had the lowest engagement rate on TikTok for posts of October 2026?
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM (SELECT c.name, 1.0 * SUM(m.likes + m.comments + m.shares + m.saves) / SUM(m.reach) AS er FROM posts p JOIN accounts a ON a.account_id = p.account_id JOIN creators c ON c.creator_id = a.creator_id JOIN platforms pl ON pl.platform_id = a.platform_id JOIN post_metrics_daily m ON m.post_id = p.post_id WHERE pl.name = 'TikTok' AND p.posted_at LIKE '2026-10%' GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY er LIMIT 1)

question: What is the total reach of all Instagram stories posted by Creator G?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(m.reach) FROM posts p JOIN accounts a ON a.account_id = p.account_id JOIN creators c ON c.creator_id = a.creator_id JOIN platforms pl ON pl.platform_id = a.platform_id JOIN post_metrics_daily m ON m.post_id = p.post_id WHERE c.name = 'Creator G' AND pl.name = 'Instagram' AND p.format = 'story'

question: How many campaigns did Orbit Audio run with our creators?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM campaigns ca JOIN brands b ON b.brand_id = ca.brand_id WHERE b.name = 'Orbit Audio'

question: Which creator has the smallest Instagram audience?
gold_sql: SELECT c.name FROM accounts a JOIN creators c ON c.creator_id = a.creator_id JOIN platforms pl ON pl.platform_id = a.platform_id WHERE pl.name = 'Instagram' ORDER BY a.followers LIMIT 1

question: What is the average fee of the contracts that have an exclusivity clause?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(fee_usd), 1) FROM contracts_index WHERE exclusivity = 1

question: How many YouTube posts did Creator H publish in August 2026?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM posts p JOIN accounts a ON a.account_id = p.account_id JOIN creators c ON c.creator_id = a.creator_id JOIN platforms pl ON pl.platform_id = a.platform_id WHERE c.name = 'Creator H' AND pl.name = 'YouTube' AND p.posted_at LIKE '2026-08%'

question: Which brand category has the most contracts?
gold_sql: SELECT category FROM (SELECT b.category, COUNT(*) AS n FROM contracts_index ci JOIN brands b ON b.brand_id = ci.brand_id GROUP BY b.category ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 1)
